Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is looking for a scale\\-focused and customer\\-obsessed Software Development Engineer.

The solutions heavily leverage technology to challenge conventional wisdom with hard data. Our SDEs solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\\-hand.
   

  

 In this role you will have the opportunity to exercise your creativity and explore ideas to simulate and quantify any aspect of the customer experience.
